adjudication.note: Product call: move regex/brotli to dev deps, or automate the fonts task server-side? Mutually exclusive approaches.

question: Triaged needs-product-decision — needs a human/product call.
summary: The issue presents two mutually exclusive approaches: (A) move regex and brotli to dev dependencies since fonts task has hardcoded laptop TTF paths and cannot run in production, or (B) fully automate the fonts task on the server — which also requires making it edit pd.css rather than just emitting CSS. Owner needs to pick an approach; if (A), removing regex from main deps in pyproject.toml is a on
